verdict.rationale: LiveKit documents its own programmatic surfaces. The CLI accesses server APIs, creates tokens, and scaffolds and deploys agents to LiveKit Cloud, and telephony supports programmatic outbound calls. Nothing documents that UI-only features such as browser Agent Builder, metrics dashboards, or deployment rollback can also be done via API, and no OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity claim, API coverage for Agent Builder, dashboard metrics and rollback, a published OpenAPI/API reference, and independent corroboration.
